title: View History Logs ON: work order history and line history are visible (work orders only)
custom_preconds:
1. A user has a role with the View History Logs toggle ON and Work orders View ON.
  2. A work order has at least one line, and both the work order and the line have some change history.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order and find the work order history / audit log.
  2. Open a line on that work order and find the line's history (its story/history).
custom_expected:
With View History Logs on, the user can open the work order history and it lists change events.

The user can also see the line-level history on the line.

History logs are for work orders only (work-order level and line level) — there is no history log for Part Sales or Purchase Orders.
viu_status: Blocked-UI (needs seeded role); 'View History Logs' toggle build-verified
evidence: Cross-toggle 'View History Logs' confirmed in build. History visibility needs live UI.
